methods.label: Combine the group proportions
methods.explanation: The sum of the frequencies of all groups equals the total count, so the sum of the relative frequencies is total count ÷ total count = 1.
methods.levelReason: The argument uses the relative-frequency definition and the elementary relationship between parts and their total.
